## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: risk ratios mixed with VXX (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -10.01%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and SPY (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +0.96%) → flat ABOVE TREND alongside credit ETFs HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.87%) → flat ABOVE TREND, so no clear tilt.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Broad sector participation vs idiosyncratic weakness: GLD (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +7.22%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +36.41%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND are lifting safe-haven/commodity flows while XLK (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.86%) → flat BELOW TREND signals tech inertia.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: +0.62% | 1M: -0.03%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.87%) → flat ABOVE TREND show neither clear tightening nor easing.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals leading vs tech lag: XLE (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +3.13%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +8.56%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while XLK (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.86%) → flat BELOW TREND; style: cyclicals/value showing relative strength.

5. US vs Global?  
US modestly steady: SPY (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +0.96%) → flat ABOVE TREND, with EM participation from EEM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +6.29%) → flat ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +3.82%) → flat ABOVE TREND — no clear regional divergence.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation present: IWM (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +1.72%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.40%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while IBIT (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +2.82%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND supports risk-on flows.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Precious metals leadership with GLD (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +7.22%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +36.41%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, while industrial metals CPER (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +9.76%) ↓ falling CORRECTION shows short-term profit taking.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy is strong: BNO (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +7.18%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +3.13%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND with clear momentum.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: broad breadth (7/11) with cyclicals (XLE, XLB) ABOVE TREND; DIVERGENCE: XLK BELOW TREND while VXX (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -10.01%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and SPY ABOVE TREND present mixed momentum — supports Neutral classification.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposures and reduce exposure to lagging tech; monitor credit (HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.87%) → flat ABOVE TREND) and volatility signals for regime shifts.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +3.13%) ABOVE TREND, Materials XLB (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech XLK (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND and Financials (sector breadth 1W: -4.29% | 1M: -1.47%) showing weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +36.41%) ABOVE TREND and Oil BNO (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +7.18%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper CPER (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +9.76%) CORRECTION and Natural Gas UNG (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -13.46%) → flat RECOVERY.

13. Key Levels?  
Watch VXX ~20 for volatility complacency (VXX (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -10.01%) ↑ rising RECOVERY), HYG/LQD spread (HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.87%) → flat ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.31%) → flat ABOVE TREND), and XLK relative to XLE as a style pivot — XLK (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND vs XLE (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +3.13%) ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Cyclicals and commodities showing relative strength (XLE (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +3.13%) ABOVE TREND; SLV (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +36.41%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk is tech weakness XLK (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND and the VXX/volatility RECOVERY divergence (VXX (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -10.01%) ↑ rising) to monitor.
